cards.content:
# Room sound
Live measurements from Sunday’s selected microphone. Less negative dBFS means louder sound. These are relative microphone levels, not calibrated room decibels. Sunday’s own replies are excluded. Sleepiness behavior is unchanged.
**Room sound** includes other voices, TV and music. **Noise floor** estimates steady background sound while speech is absent. Only measurements are retained; this feature does not record audio.

## Dual microphone experiment
Off restores the original mono capture path. On adds independent stereo data for local direction analysis; it does not steer the head or change STT/wake. Measure microphone spacing and confirm which physical side is channel 0 before trusting LEFT/RIGHT. Left/right are from Sunday’s point of view. Spacing 0 means uncalibrated.
